key_patterns: Adapters are plain ESM classes that structurally satisfy a duck-typed interface (no `implements`). Subprocess calls go through command() in src/process.js using argv arrays (never shell strings). DadAdapter.logged() wraps a subprocess and writes `${label}.log` evidence on both success and failure. compose() prepends ['compose','-p',this.id,'-f',this.file]. Several phase methods currently INLINE the full ['compose','-p',this.id,'-f',this.file, ...] argv directly into logged() rather than calling compose(); Move 3 extracts a composeRun() helper that prepends those four elements and appends the rest verbatim. sql() uses `psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1` (both flags load-bearing). Mode branching: run.data.options.mode === 'exploration' vs acceptance changes which artifacts build() and database() emit and the summary strings — this branching stays in DAD, NOT in the base helper.
